requestCodes.code:
client = LazopApiClient::Client.new(url, appkey, appSecret)
request = LazopApiClient::Request.new('/wallet/giftcode/request')
request.add_api_parameter("amount", "0.01")
request.add_api_parameter("quantity", "1")
request.add_api_parameter("transfer_order_id", "test001")
request.add_api_parameter("end_timestamp", "1740260653001")
request.add_api_parameter("start_timestamp", "1640260000001")
response = client.execute(request)
puts response.success?
puts response.body

client = lazop.LazopClient(url, appkey ,appSecret)
request = lazop.LazopRequest('/wallet/giftcode/request')
request.add_api_param('amount', '0.01')
request.add_api_param('quantity', '1')
request.add_api_param('transfer_order_id', 'test001')
request.add_api_param('end_timestamp', '1740260653001')
request.add_api_param('start_timestamp', '1640260000001')
response = client.execute(request)
print(response.type)
print(response.body)
